title: Murphy Trucker Cap
subtitle: Pine Green & Yellow
description: It's funny, I love this green but until now, didn't actually own any hats in this colour. When I was growing up my grandfather's favourite cap was a John Deere trucker hat so I've done my level best to match that classic green and yellow combination. This trucker hat features the largest patch I've produced yet, crafted with both embroidered and woven detailing. To me nothing says 80's tractor cap like an oversized patch. Oh... and the quote? Well the hat is called Murphy so... if you know you know. The padded front panel and visor are decorated with a braided rope trim, while the headband lining offers a cosy fit.

accordions.title: Curving the Peak
accordions.body: All my hats ship with a flat visor or peak to give you the option to either keep it that way or curve it if you prefer. If like me you prefer your hats with a curved visor it's best to hold it over a steaming kettle or pan for 10-15 seconds before holding the visor in the curved position. If you just bend it without heat you risk cracking the plastic insert.

accordions.title: Designed by J.
accordions.body: I design all Futureboy hats from scratch. Every measurement and material choice is agonised over to an embarrassing degree, all in an attempt at getting close to what I believe is the perfect cap.

accordions.title: Made in China
accordions.body:
China? I thought you said these were premium hats? Doesn't that mean they need to be made in the US or somewhere even cooler, like Japan? Yeah I'll be honest I was really expecting, and kinda hoping to see 'Made in Japan' here.

I get it. I spent almost a year sourcing hats from factories all over the world. In the US, Europe and yes, also in Japan. Hell even I wanted it to say Made in Japan here. I didn't expect a small independent factory in China to turn out the best cap I've ever worn. But here we are.

title: Shermer Trucker Cap
subtitle: Red & Gold
description: Here's a punchy variation on the script logo design from the Miyagi. Red and gold yellow are such a great combo and I decided to pay a little tribute to the aphoristic wisdom of Ferris Bueller too. The vintage-style script design is printed in a gold yellow, while the padded front panel and visor feature that now standard rope trim. The headband is fully lined for a secure and comfortable fit.

title: Striker Trucker Cap
subtitle: Indigo Denim
description: It doesn't get much more Americana than a denim trucker hat so figured I may as well go all in with a red, white and blue patch. This indigo denim is incredible fine which means the structured cap keeps its shape beautifully. I'm really happy with these shots of the hat but let me tell you, in hand, the colours on this cap are just glorious.

title: Tyrell Trucker Cap
subtitle: Grey Corduroy
description: I'm a huge fan of corduroy when it comes to caps. Fine, medium, chunky... with the right hat any weight can work. With the Tyrell trucker I've chosen a mid profile, structured cap and gone with a fine to medium pale grey corduroy. Patch wise, it's the usual mix of embroidered and woven elements but design wise I wanted to do something that evoked retro futuristic vibes. An 80's version of 2023... way cooler than the 2023 we actually got.

title: Miyagi Trucker Cap
subtitle: Black & Orange
description: As much as I love patches I decided to try out a larger screen print design for this black trucker cap. The classic script design is printed in a warm orange-y red to give it more of an aged vintage vibe. The padded front panel and visor join features a rope trim. Not always, but on a classic padded trucker like this you can't leave out the rope detail! The headband inside the cap is fully lined all the way round to make sure you get a cosy fit.

title: Porkchop Trucker Cap — Burgundy
subtitle: Burgundy & Gold
description: Despite the fact that Burgundy holds no real sway with the younger generation it remains one of my all time favourite colours. It goes with grey, blue, black or green and simply reeks of old fashioned charm and style. This hat sports a pale gold and burgundy patch featuring a combination of embroidered and woven details. Padded front panel and visor with rope trim detail. Padded headband with lined front panel for maximum comfort.

subtitle: Navy & Gold

The pale gold patch features a combination of embroidered and woven details. The padded front panel and visor aren't complete fwithout that classic rope detail. The headband is fully lined for maximum comfort, an essential addition if like me you're in the habit of wearing a hat all day!
